summary: The change adds deterministic current-profile and supported-legacy retry coverage for the requested recovery paths without an actionable defect.

evidence: tests/vps-deploy-guards.test.ts:594-596 adds a process-stop hook immediately before the reload command.
tests/vps-deploy-guards.test.ts:762-784 verifies same-SHA retry restarts the previous release, restores its public identity, records rolled_back, and succeeds on the next retry.
tests/vps-deploy-guards.test.ts:785-799 verifies the supported legacy profile refuses cross-codec rollback while leaving the candidate selected with a candidate_ready receipt.
